objective: Add bounded, provenance-preserving native DR24 Lightcurves acquisition at the Observation Service and API boundary without changing the frozen v0.2.0 feature or model contracts.

previous_knowledge_consumed.detail: The existing ObservationService uses ALeRCE; DR24 payload retrieval was previously isolated in a probe.
DR24 HMJD, photometry, color coefficient, catflags and OID partition metadata require explicit handling.

expected_improvement: Add a bounded indexed DR24 objectid acquisition contract.
Expose source-native lightcurve payloads through the Observation Service and explicit API route.
Preserve OID, filter, field, readout-channel, schema and payload-hash provenance.
Keep scientific normalization blocked until source semantics are approved and validated.

reliability.before: No bounded native DR24 indexed lightcurve adapter was exposed by the Observation Service.
reliability.after: The adapter requires indexed objectid lookup, rejects duplicate/unrequested OIDs, rejects non-integer/boolean/non-positive returned OIDs without lossy coercion, and rejects catalog nepochs/payload-row mismatches. Dedicated regression tests cover malformed OIDs and epoch-count mismatch.

reproducibility.before: No per-OID canonical payload hash or catalog schema hash was recorded by the application path.
reproducibility.after: The adapter records per-OID payload SHA-256, catalog schema SHA-256, requested/returned/missing OIDs, and native provenance. The dependent live API smoke verified exact payload-hash parity for three pinned OIDs (417 epochs); a seven-OID browser smoke is being extended on the dependent Workbench branch.

evidence: Current PR head 06669fe6c366771d5ff1c364c7c58815d1e1c03c passed workflow run 42232182784: Format Check, Lint, Cumulative Lifecycle Gate, Test Suite, Runtime Smoke Tests, Build & Verify Package, Dependency Audit and CI Gate all succeeded.
Test Suite: 655 passed, 10 skipped, 9 warnings, 0 failures.
Scientific Validation contract run 42232182779 passed, but source-backed DR24/ALeRCE, StarEmbed, source-provenance and historical-reference jobs were skipped. This is not scientific validation.
Regression coverage rejects catalog nepochs/payload-row mismatches and rejects returned OID values that are non-integer, boolean, non-positive, or require lossy integer coercion.

Dependent API/HATS run 42063653144 verified three pinned OIDs and 417 epochs; all three canonical payload SHA-256 values matched independent HATS references. This run predates the latest strict-ID hardening commit.
Dependent five-OID Workbench run 42232639126 passed for 650 epochs, but it predates the latest strict-ID hardening commit. A seven-OID browser run is pending against the dependent Workbench branch.
The 10 skipped tests remain unresolved: 3 require frozen feature/raw-detection artifacts and 7 require the production v0.2.0 model artifact.

known_risks: DR24-to-ALeRCE photometric equivalence is not established.
Production catflags policy is not approved.
No general cross-OID identity rule is implemented.

findings: Raw DR24 acquisition can be implemented without changing the frozen v0.2.0 feature contract.
The raw source adapter must not imply that HMJD is MJD or that raw DR24 measurements are inference-ready.

open_blockers: The 10 skipped tests still require frozen feature/raw-detection artifacts and the production model artifact. Provision them through a controlled, hash-verified test workflow before claiming inference-path coverage.
Rerun live API/HATS parity on the latest adapter commit 06669fe6c366771d5ff1c364c7c58815d1e1c03c. Existing API parity run predates the latest strict-ID hardening commit.
No validated DR24-to-source-neutral normalization, time-basis policy, photometric mapping, production quality policy, or general OID identity/grouping is implemented.
No DR24 feature generation or model inference is enabled; do not use native DR24 payloads with the frozen v0.2.0 model.
The 5–10 source-target application acceptance test, descriptive QC, exports, and full reproducibility bundle remain open.
The 30–50 source-target guided Park demonstration remains open.

knowledge_carried_forward: Keep raw DR24 acquisition separate from normalized model observations until time, photometry, quality and identity contracts pass scientific validation.
Never silently substitute ALeRCE when DR24 acquisition fails.
IRSA documents ZTF object IDs as per-filter/field/quadrant identities; one astrophysical source may have multiple OIDs. Keep raw OIDs separate until AOIC cross-match is implemented and validated.
The versioned API contract in docs/api/API_V1.md now documents the raw DR24 endpoint, optional extra, request bounds, source-native response fields, error codes, and scientific/identity limitations.

The v2.1 handbook now includes a dated 2026-11-04 section for the DR24 raw endpoint, its source semantics and identity boundary, current acceptance blockers, CPVS membership status, and baseline/release controls.

The current handbook records that all 11602 CPVS candidate-only objects have a finite positive common Per value; missing common period does not explain the discrepancy. Table 2 Ng/Nr counts also require reconciliation with raw archive detections.
